title: Scorpion's revenge on Quan Chi in Mortal Kombat X
subject: scorpion
description:
Was Scorpion right to take his revenge? 👇

The truth about the Shirai Ryu massacre and what Scorpion's revenge cost Earthrealm. Spoilers for Mortal Kombat 4, Mortal Kombat X and Mortal Kombat 11.

Fan-made content. Not affiliated with or endorsed by NetherRealm Studios or Warner Bros. Games. Game images © their respective owners.

scenes.text: The Lin Kuei never touched Hanzo's family.
Quan Chi slaughtered the Shirai Ryu himself and blamed Sub-Zero's clan, aiming Scorpion like a weapon.
In Mortal Kombat 4, Scorpion learned the truth and dragged Quan Chi into the Netherrealm.
In 2015's Mortal Kombat X, he reached Quan Chi in chains and took his head. But the sorcerer had finished one last spell, and it freed the fallen Elder God Shinnok.
By Mortal Kombat 11, Hanzo was human again, Grandmaster of a rebuilt Shirai Ryu.
He got his revenge twice, and his wife and son still never came home.
